name: Boku wa Kimi to Koi ni Ochiru
source:
When you came back to the town you grew up in after a year of absence, you couldn't have possibly expected a one-of-a-kind encounter to be waiting for you.

It might be the guy you used to have a crush on, your childhood friend who matured while you were away, or even the attractive, yet mysterious teacher.

Each of them have their secrets, but they wear their hearts on their sleeves, making this a realistic story of innocent love.

Now... who is the one for you?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101125052927/http://www.furyu.jp/mobile/otome/koiochi/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
离开一年后，回到从小长大的城镇时，你绝对不会想到，一场独一无二的邂逅，正等待着自己。

对方可能是曾经暗恋的男生，在你离开期间变得成熟的青梅竹马，甚至是那位迷人而神秘的老师。

每个人都有自己的秘密，却也坦率流露内心的感情，交织成一段真实而纯粹的恋爱故事。

那么……谁才是属于你的那个人？

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101125052927/http://www.furyu.jp/mobile/otome/koiochi/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
